setting_0.description: SOSTOOLS v4.03 (submodule tools/sosbc/SOSTOOLS) with MOSEK; barrier degree 16 for every benchmark (the original scripts used 8, and 14 for DUFF_FIN_UNR_BOX; at degree 8 and 12 no certificate exists for DUFF_FIN_UNR_BOX, and DUFF_FIN_UNR_BALL needs 12); multipliers sized so that every product reaches the barrier degree (quadratic box constraints); B >= 1 on the boundary of the domain so the certificate holds for all time. Benchmarks with non-polynomial dynamics or sets are reported as unsupported.
